messages.content: 有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？

function.name: movies_search

year.description: The release year of the movie.

message.content: 截至目前（2023 年底），全球票房收入最高的电影是《阿凡達》（Avatar，2009 年）。該片在全球範圍內累計票房超過 28 億美元，保持了多年的領先地位。第二名則是《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》（Avengers: Endgame，2019 年），票房約 27 億美元。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" which means "What is the highest-grossing movie ever?" They want the highest grossing film worldwide. That would be "Avatar" (2009) or "Avengers: Endgame"? As of 2023, "Avatar" remains top worldwide gross. But we need to confirm. We can use the movies_search function? It expects title and year. But we don't know the title. We could search for "highest grossing movie". But the function only searches by title and year. So maybe we can't use it. We might just answer manually. The question is straightforward. Provide answer: "Avatar" (2009). Also mention "Avengers: Endgame" is second. Provide context. Use Chinese.
